chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir, from Dawood al-Raqqi who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the word of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'and His Throne was upon the water.' He said: 'What are they saying?' I said: 'They say that the Throne was upon the water and the Lord was above it.' So he said: 'They have lied. Whoever claims this has made God a carried one, and described Him with the attribute of a creature, and it follows that the thing carrying Him would be stronger than Him.'
I said: 'Explain it to me, may I be your sacrifice!' So he said: 'Indeed God loaded His religion and His knowledge upon the water before there was earth, sky, jinn, humans, sun, or moon.'

Then when God intended to create the creatures, He scattered them before Him and said to them: 'Who is your Lord?' The first to speak was the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and the Imams (God's blessings be upon them), and they said: 'You are our Lord.' So He loaded them with the knowledge and the religion.

Then He said to the angels: 'These are the carriers of My religion, My knowledge, and My trustees among My creation, and they are the ones who will be held accountable.' Then He said to the Children of Adam: 'Acknowledge to God the Lordship, and to these persons the wilayah and obedience.' So they said: 'Yes, our Lord, we acknowledge.'

Then God said to the angels: 'Bear witness!' So the angels said: 'We bear witness, lest they say tomorrow that we were unaware of this. Or lest you say: it was only our fathers who committed shirk before, and we were their offspring after them — so would You destroy us for what the wrongdoers did?' O Dawood! Our wilayah is confirmed upon them in the Covenant.

key_terms.الْعَرْشُ: The Throne — a Quranic concept for divine sovereignty and governance. Imam al-Sadiq here reinterprets it away from any physical-spatial meaning.
key_terms.الْمَحْمُولُ: Carried one — the Imam uses this term to show that applying physical directionality to God would reduce Him to a creature.
key_terms.الْمِيثَاقُ: The Covenant — the primordial agreement between God and all souls before creation, central to Shia theology of Imamate.
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةُ: Wilayah — guardianship, authority, and spiritual leadership of the Imams, here confirmed as an obligation binding on all humans from before creation.
key_terms.حَمَلَةُ الدِّينِ: Carriers of the religion — the Imams as the designated bearers of divine knowledge and religious authority.

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'His Throne was upon the water' according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) addresses a theological question about the Quranic verse 'His Throne was upon the water' (11:7), rejecting the literalist interpretation that would imply God is physically carried or located above the Throne. The Imam explains that the 'Throne upon water' refers to God placing His religion and knowledge upon the water as a primordial trust before all of creation existed. He then reveals the cosmological event of the primordial covenant (mithaq), where God scattered the souls of all beings, asked them to acknowledge His Lordship, and the Prophet, Ali, and the Imams were the first to respond, thus being entrusted with divine knowledge and religion — an authority that was witnessed and confirmed upon all of humanity by the angels.
word_analysis: your ransom/sacrifice (may I be sacrificed for you)

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer, from Dawood Al Raqqy who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [11:7] and His Throne was upon the water. So heasws said: ‘What are they (people) saying?’ I said, ‘They are saying that the Throne (الْعَرْشُ) was upon the water and the Lordazwj above it’. So heasws said: ‘They are lying! The one who claim this, so he has rendered Allahazwj as a carried One, and described Himazwj by a description of the creatures, and necessitated it that the thing which is carrying Himazwj is stronger than Himazwj’.

I said, ‘Clarify it for me, may I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>!’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Loaded His<sup>azwj</sup> Religion and His<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge upon the water, before the coming into being of the earth, or sky, or Jinn, or humans, or sun, or moon.

So when Allahazwj Intended that Heazwj Creates the creatures, Scattered them in front of Himazwj, and Said to them: “Who is your Lordazwj?” So the first one to speak was Rasool-Allahsaww and Amir Al-Momineenasws, and the Imamsasws, so they said: ‘Youazwj are ourasws Lordazwj’.

So He<sup>azwj</sup> Loaded the Knowledge and the Religion, then Said to the Angels: “They<sup>asws</sup> are the carriers of My<sup>azwj</sup> Religion, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge, and My<sup>azwj</sup> Trustees among My<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and they would be asked from’. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Said to the Children of Adam<sup>as</sup>: “Acknowledge to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> with the Lordship, and to these persons<sup>asws</sup> with the Wilayah and the obedience!” So they said, ‘Yes, our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, we acknowledge’.

So Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Said to the Angels: “Bear witness!” So the Angels said: ‘We bear witness upon that they cannot be saying tomorrow that we were ignorant of this’. Or you should be saying, ‘But rather, it was our fathers who associated (committed Shirk), and we were the offspring from after them, so should we be destroyed with what the false ones did?’ O Dawood! Our<sup>asws</sup> Wilayah is confirmed upon them in the Covenant’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir from Dawud al-Ruqyy who has said the following.

“I asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah, ‘. . His Throne existed on water . [11:8].’” The Imam asked, “What do they say about it?” I said, “They say that al-‘Arsh (the Throne) was on the water and the Lord was on top of it.” The Imam then said, “They have said a lie. Whoever would think that way he has considered Allah as being carried and has described Him with the qualities of the creatures which involves that the thing that carries Him is stronger than Him.”

I then asked, may Allah take my soul for your service, please explain it to me.” The Imam then said, “Allah made water to carry His religion and His knowledge before there were the earth, the heavens, the Jinns, the human beings, the sun and the moon.

When Allah willed to create the creatures He spread them before His-self and said to them, “Who is you Lord? The first ones who spoke were the Holy Prophet and Amirul Mu‘minin Ali (a.s.) and the Imams (a.s.). They all said, “You are our Lord.” He then made them to carry the religion and the knowledge.

Then He spoke to the angels, “These are the carriers of My religion and knowledge, My trustees in My people and they are responsible (or questions will be asked about them). Then Allah spoke to the children of Adam, “Acknowledge that Allah is the Lord and acknowledge that these people are the authorities (of Allah) among you and that obedience to them is obligatory. They said, “O our Lord, we acknowledge.”

Allah then told the angels, “Bear witness to this.” The angels said, “We bear witness so that they, tomorrow will not say, ‘We were not aware of this or say that our forefathers have worshipped idols before us and we were only their offspring. Will You then destroy us just because what the followers of falsehood have done?” O Dawud, our authority over them was strongly stressed up on at the time of the covenant.”
